##### Project general facts

Rehan Residences is a contemporary G+P+9-storey development located within the vibrant Maryam Island beach community in Sharjah. The project offers 162 elegantly designed studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully planned to provide spacious layouts and a comfortable modern lifestyle. With its refined architectural approach and well-balanced proportions, the building reflects a seamless blend of functionality and contemporary design within a curated waterfront setting.

Residents of Rehan Residences benefit from a wide selection of premium amenities designed to support an active and relaxed lifestyle. These include state-of-the-art fitness centres, temperature-controlled swimming pools, children’s play areas, barbecue zones, and beautifully landscaped gardens. The development also features a private swimming pool, a fully equipped gym, podium landscaping with lush greenery, and direct access to an 800-meter seaside promenade. In addition, residents enjoy proximity to retail outlets, cafés, dining venues, and a 4000 sqm community park with walking and jogging trails, a basketball court, and recreational green spaces.

The interiors are finished with premium materials, ensuring a refined and durable living environment throughout. The kitchens are fully equipped with appliances, combining modern functionality with practical design. The units are delivered unfurnished, allowing residents the freedom to personalize their homes according to their own taste and lifestyle preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Maryam Island is located in downtown Sharjah overlooking the Arabian Sea. It provides easy access to Sharjah and the neighbouring Emirates of Dubai, Ajman, and Umm Al Quwain via the Al Taawun and Al Ittihad Roads.  

 Set to take the tourism industry of Sharjah by storm, Maryam Island promises to be the ultimate leisure and lifestyle destination with a range of alluring amenities and unique gastronomical offerings.  

 Combined with the utmost privacy, the serene residential spaces offer visitors, tenants, owners, and guests the experience of a lifetime, with a relaxing promenade and a wealth of upscale amenities.
